metadata.title: New Wave Portrait with Compact Block Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a subject in dark sunglasses with a distinct hand-to-chin gesture, paired with a compact, right-aligned typographic block.
triggerTerms: portrait with hand under chin and sunglasses
condensed red text on black block
excludeWhen: soft or painterly lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man wearing dark aviator-style sunglasses, resting his chin on his hand with fingers splayed across the jawline. The subject is set against a stark white background, creating a high-key effect that emphasizes the dark textures of his hair and corduroy-like blazer. In the upper right corner, a dense rectangular block of red condensed typography sits on a black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark silhouette against a pure white void
Hand gesture framing the lower face and creating a diagonal line
Typographic block balanced in the negative space of the upper right
Reflective sunglasses obscuring eyes to create an enigmatic persona

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hand and the bridge of the sunglasses form the central vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sunglasses, move down the hand to the chin, then jump to the high-contrast text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space surrounds the head, particularly on the left and top.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the background and subject; high saturation in the accent text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif used for all text to maintain a blocky, architectural feel.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular container for text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Offers a cleaner, more modern geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with short dark hair wearing dark aviator sunglasses and a dark navy textured blazer. He is resting his chin on his hand with fingers spread. The background is pure, seamless white. Lighting is bright and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the upper right corner, add a solid black vertical rectangle. Inside the rectangle, typeset the text in an extra-condensed bold red sans-serif font, stacked and left-aligned with minimal leading.

verificationChecks: Is the text block in the upper right corner?
Is the font extra-condensed and red?

adjustableVariables: Text block color (e.g., yellow on black)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original album title

mustAchieve: Clean separation from the white background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hand gesture looks natural and anatomically correct.
Verify the text is legible despite the tight condensation.
Check that the red color is vibrant and does not bleed into the black.
Confirm the high-key lighting doesn't wash out the skin tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + high-key white background + dark sunglasses + hand-to-face gesture + [Color] condensed text on [Color] block in corner.
